steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: *huff*... C'mooon, even though it has to across the river, you're STILL on me?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: That's the lockdown perimeter dead ahead! No more runnin' for Kafka!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Freaking dang heavy-as-butt box. Knocks a Kafka's lungs out...
I told you before. This has bearing upon far more than you alone, Kafka.
You're running straight into the search for you. If you do want to escape, then this is the wrong direction.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Okay, you WANT li'l Kafka to bounce?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Are you just keepin' me at arm's length all the time 'cause you don't wanna get involved with me?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Siiii-lennnnce.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I just don't want to put too much pressure on you. I'm with Rhine Lab, after all.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: My colleagues maintain far too much prejudice, owing to your... background.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: 'It fits just fine that a street hustler like Kafka would run this sort of illegal business'...

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: But Miss Silence doesn't think a Kafka'd do bad?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: My hope is it wasn't you... and more than me, your mentor, Mr. Laurens, specifically sought me out to stand in your corner.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Mr. Laurens relates admittedly that when he first took you in, you retained a number of 'bad habits' from the streets.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But they were only minor tricks learned for your own survival, and meant nothing inherent.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Mr. Laurens sure knows his Kafkaology.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: He's been swell to me, sure, I can tell you that.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'm here in the picture because I do not want to see my friend wronged by Rhine Lab's negligence.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: The instinct imposed on you by your living conditions should not be any reason for others to question you.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But if you absolutely cannot absolve yourself of culpability for theft of the test subject, I can only fulfill my obligations.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Which is why, right now, I need you to cooperate with me and clear up the facts. Things can still be turned around.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: This box... this box shackled to you, is the test subject inside it?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Whoa, whoa, that's my secret to keep!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Yannow the mad—freaking—effort it took for li'l ol' Kafka to lug this box all the way here? Heck, no one else would even—

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: What, don't ignore me here!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Kafka. Your hands. They're bleeding.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Wha? Sheesh, I didn't even notice! Naww, it's okay, that's just a fact of Kafka life. No need to worry at all!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Hey, I'm not a kid here! Put me the sweet heck down!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: My medical drone can help your recovery.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Buh.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: (C'mon, Silence, you're pintsize as I am. Where d'you even hide that strength...)

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Kafka, you don't have to assume this air of resistance.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Hold still!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: This customary approach of yours is uncalled for here.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Where's the key? I'll put the specimen back for you.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Mmrf. Put the Kafka on the floor.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Stop struggling! My drone is still treating you!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Silence. Put me down.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: You hear the sirens thataway?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: You think your Rhine Lab researcherhood lets you wrangle cops too?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Lesson, Silence: never ever let anyone else hear your true mind that easy!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You have secrets you're attempting to hide.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You have a mentor who cares for you now. A new life of calm and stability.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Why would you risk all of this to do something that benefits you in no way?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I don't make promises I can't keep, Kafka.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But I cannot look on while innocent people are implicated through Rhine Lab's negligence.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: So why am I seeing you now? Silence, is this about helping the innocent, or saving face for Rhine Lab?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: All I know—is that my friend needs help.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Huh. Friend...

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Yannow, I just tried to find any proof you were lyin' there. Guess my polygraph says no today.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Might be you really can do the things I can't, Silence.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Alrighty. Ya got any major evidence to help a Kafka's case out?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Given all other surveillance data was destroyed by interference, this was the one and only means I could rescue.
Twelve hours ago...

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: (Oof, I can't be this beat...)

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: (Objection! Kafka isn't even trying to drag this out, the dumb box just weighs a ton!)

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: (I did NOT want to draw attention by bein' all loud!)

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: (Still too early for 'em to be clockin' in! Alright, Kafka, shut up aaand...)
Inside a markedly spacious room, a small little figure pushes at a huge box completely out of proportion to her height.
She stumbles in her step, she proceeds slow and steady, but she never halts for a moment.
As she passes a half-ajar laboratory door, she suddenly freezes.
She can hear her own heart beating.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: (Why's there people?)

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Alright, we'll input all the data, then simulate a reproduction one more time.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: If the output results are a good fit, then we've saved your industry reputation.

steps.name: Remorseful Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Researcher Silence, you've been up all night rescuing this paper. Please, take a break.

steps.name: Remorseful Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: I'll handle the remaining work myself. I promise you there'll be no more problems.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'm accustomed to working at night. You should be celebrating that our efforts last evening at least avoided Rhine Lab becoming the laughing stock of our profession.

steps.name: Remorseful Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: I'm sorry...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I know you're defiant about this. Shifting numbers around is a common practice in the industry, and we are by and large tacitly aware of it.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But everything has to have a line. Cross it, and pulling back becomes very difficult.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'm not criticizing you at all. I just hope we can always keep in mind where the boundaries of research lie.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: After all, ingenuity is what shot Rhine Lab to recognition within Colum—

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Who's there?

steps.name: Nervous Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: I didn't see anyone.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: (Figures Silence would.)

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: (Probably saw me and all?)

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: (Hope you're not trying to excuse yourself. C'mon, Kafka, you knew the lab was right there.)

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: (And we're here. Is this seriously the job?)

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: (Real shame...)
Flowers're so pretty in full bloom.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: These are records of the first ten minutes after the test subject was stolen.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: A researcher working overtime noticed the peculiarity, and reported it to Defense.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But before Defense could launch an internal investigation, someone had sounded the alarm.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Not only do all leads at the scene point to you, but you happened to perfectly establish that you were present.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: You saw me, didn'tcha?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Yes. And I submitted my testimony.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Likewise, I raised objections too. Due to all concurrent surveillance records suffering interference, they were classed as inadmissible evidence.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But I tried to get a colleague who specializes in data recovery to restore a portion.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Kafka, who was it directing you from outside the frame?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Kafka sez: I don't think this evidence is gonna be enough to help me.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But if you can just return the test specimen, that will be my foothold to wield said evidence, and apply to restart the investigation.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Even still, that's one heck of an uphill climb.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Think back for me, Silence. When you were there in the lab, did ya see anyone else apart from me?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Hear anyone else's voice?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: No... but being engaged in conversation with my colleague likely caused me to overlook any other sounds.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Uh-huh, but'cha see, if they shoot back and ask, how can you prove this wasn't the person on tape just acting?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: How d'ya respond then, Silence?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I have no way to prove that...

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Yep. You have no way to prove it.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: So are you still willin' to trust me?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I am.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Well, that's a headscratcher.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Yannow, I'd like to ask you somethin' too now, Kafka to Silence.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: What if that whole deal on tape really was just me acting? What would you do then?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: There's no motivation for you to take superfluous action...

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Not that.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: You're here for me, Silence.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: That proves... I can believe a heck of a lot that scared me to even think before.
The sirens are still blaring close by.
But Kafka doesn't fear the people searching for her.
This perplexed-looking, side-of-justice guest of hers, who strained herself just to 'keep this appointment,' is what she minds more right now.
Kafka trusts that right now, a million problems must be whirling through Silence's mind all at once.
She begins to hesitate. Her ever-unflustered heart grows more and more apprehensive.
'Maybe I shouldn't have led her here.'
She can almost hear her own heart beating.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: You look lost as all heck, Silence.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: I don't wanna get you into trouble. You oughta hit the road, quick-like.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: This makes no sense. What calls for you to take such a tremendous risk and stay here?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I can hear them searching for you!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You've been homeless in Columbia. You know what follows when an ordinary woman with no status or means is arrested by the police under these circumstances.

spans.text: You've been homeless in Columbia. You know what follows when an ordinary woman with no status or means is arrested by the police under

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Being sent to the frontier may well qualify as the least worst outcome.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But I haven't seen the slightest hint of despair in your eyes... You haven't given up.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: And here li'l Kafka thought she was keepin' her secrets snug as a safe.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: It's no big deal to me if I get misunderstood. You really don't gotta worry at all, Silence.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Even if they pack me off someplace far away, heck, I'm still confident I'll survive.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Homelessness, jailtime... those don't scare me. They don't scare a Kafka at all.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Kafka, you can excuse these prospects as a fact of your life as much as you want.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But why should an innocent woman suffer meaningless punishment? That's not your mode of life.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: This is a matter concerning Rhine Lab. I am bound to ensure your fair treatment.

spans.text: This is a matter concerning Rhine Lab. I am

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Even if you do go to prison for it, I am still obligated to ascertain the truth and secure your release.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But right now, so long as you return the specimen, this can all end completely differently.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: So that's what you're thinkin'?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: You see things a way different than I do. Nothin' like anyone I've ever known...

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Alright, alrighty.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Guess I don't wanna let you down either then!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Joke is I lost the key, but the punchline? Kafka's got other ways into this box.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Watch this!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Heeeeeyaaaah—

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Stop that! Forcefully destroying the container like this might damage the specimen!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Yaaaah—

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Yaaah—yeesh, this hurts—owwwwowowow—

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: This thing's megahard. Don't think one Kafka's got the strength.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Could you lend me your medical drone just another sec?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: That should help a little. Don't be so reckless.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: As for the box... I didn't come completely unequipped for self-defense.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Open sesame! Man, Silence, you're the dream!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Guess it's for real. Some stuff I can't do, you just wave your fingers and it's done.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: No, this was just...
The contents of the box meet the light of day once more, and their brilliant gleam illuminates two faces with two completely different expressions.
Shock here, satisfaction there.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: The test subject... it's gone.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Test subject? Hey, I never fessed up to looting any laboratory!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: These suckers are MY shears, and without 'em, I don't even put food on the table. I can't just toss these things away.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But I clearly saw you taking the specimen in the recording.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: You mean the tape you just showed me?

a.text: 'What if that whole deal on tape really was just me acting? What would you do then?'

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You were drawing attention away from someone else?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Who was it?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Does that matter any? Everyone's dead set that I stole it for a fact.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Doesn't even matter what ol' Kafka did with it. Coulda hidden it, coulda trashed it. Same difference any which way.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: 'Cause the specimen don't matter, and Kafka don't matter neither.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: 'Kafka, that's our thief.' Shutting the book on the whole stupid thing sooner, that's what matters to those guys.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: No one's seriously gonna listen to anything from a pintsize gardener what came from nothing.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'm still listening, Kafka.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: But what if I was tricking you on purpose, huh?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: *sigh* I'm mentally prepared for it... After all, kids like you tend to cause very specific kinds of headaches. You love to keep people guessing, and hate to ask for help in any straightforward manner.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Call me a kid one more time, Silence, I'm gonna turbo-lose it!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: But you really can't help me this time, Silence, because over this entire thing, I didn't see this specimen once.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: I'm just lucky I didn't miss my chance to tell you goodbye.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: So could you do me one final favor, Silence?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: I've got this little gift saved for Mr. Laurens. If you could just pass it onto him, in a Kafka's place.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: The stuff's stashed in the Rhine Lab HQ, where I first met you.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: That... that's impossible! All external personnel are mandated to undergo strict inspection when entering and exiting the building—when did you—

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Somethin' tells me you could make a good guess.
Ten days earlier...

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Why were those guys at the door starin' holes in Kafka? She do a wrong thing or what?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Don't mind them; Defense are just accustomed to their job. We don't often have... unfamiliar faces showing up.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Stay close, and don't get lost. Also, remember now: if anyone else gives you trouble for being external personnel, call me right away.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Newsflash: Kafka, not some kid!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I've neglected to introduce myself. I'm—

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Silence. Heheh, Mr. Laurens drilled it into me how I gotta listen to you.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Fine... additionally, be careful with what you're holding. It's not a display item by any means.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Oh, yeah, the folks all call me...

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Uh, wait, somethin' tells me Kafka's already let the name slip!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Folks? But your files indicated you only had one relative in Laurens, the legendary gardener. Do you have siblings too?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: That's a new thing! There was a time before Kafka the gardener! You don't know all the places I've been and all the friends I've made!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You mean when you were homeless?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: What, you lookin' down on me too?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Sure, I only just started learning gardening, but Laurens says my skills would be way enough to help you guys finish cultivatin' your test samples—

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Kafka, your past experiences will not be a basis I judge you on. I hope that in the time to come, we'll work cordially together.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'll help assimilate you into this place during the experiment. Welcome to—

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Wow, that's a beautiful plant! Never seen by Kafkakind before! Why's it in a glass cover?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: This is the fruit of Director of Ecological Muelsyse's research; it's a species already extinct in the wild. In natural conditions, without Rhine Lab's intervention, it would have an infinitesimal probability of survival.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Oh, 'cause it's too eye-catching. Gets targeted too easily. If you wanna live, first you gotta learn how to hide.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: That is exactly one of the directions Rhine Lab is taking its intervention. Did you do your homework beforehand?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Don't gotta. It's somethin' a Kafka just knows.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Why don'tcha straight up get Mr. Laurens in for the experiment?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Unfortunately, Mr. Laurens didn't pass our probe questionnaire. I can't imagine how we'd reconcile his and our attitudes towards treatment of the specimens.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Mr. Laurens believes the achievements Rhine Lab makes should be for all to know, and holds firm that we should allow people to witness the beauty of these specimens once again.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Hah. The ultimate goal of the gardener.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Yes. Be that as it may, the Rhine Lab ethos is that we endeavor to seek possibilities for a species's survival. Mr. Laurens's thinking regarding these exceptional flora is, well, overly...

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Selfish?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Narrow.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: From the researcher's perspective, we worry how difficult it would be to collaborate harmoniously, despite his renowned skills.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: You guys talk down Mr. Laurens way too much.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: When you look at him now, you're lookin' at a guy who's been through difficult times—heck, gone through unspeakable things. That's why he's so used to tacklin' stuff from his own angle.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Research shouldn't mix with the interpersonal. Our respect for Mr. Laurens does not imply that we can ignore the discrepancies.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But we are surprised at how astonishingly well you meet our requirements, Kafka, as the student of Mr. Laurens.

spans.text: surprised at how astonishingly well you meet our requirements, Kafka, as the student of Mr. Laurens.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: See, it's 'cause I never like to let a good job go! Doesn't matter if it's with Mr. Laurens or with you guys.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Say, once I start up work, does Mr. Laurens still get to come and spectate the experiment?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: We can discuss that later.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Sure, then... I wanna tour around this lobby a little more.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: These plants really got an allure a gardener just can't resist.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Man, so pretty... It's givin' all it's got to survive.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Indeed. But without our help, they'd be no more than nutrients in mud.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'll be waiting for you in the laboratory, Kafka.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Silence!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Thanks for helping me before.
A small little figure sees a drooping plant beneath a glass bell, trying its hardest to stretch forth its branches.
Fragile. Delicate.
'Borrow power, and survive.'
Kafka can hear her own heart beating.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: I planted a seed of one of the specimens there, all secret. Might not ever bud.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: I bet'cha it'd really make Mr. Laurens's day for a present. He's been looking forward to this forever.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: But then again, it's property of Rhine Lab in the end, so you make the call, Silence.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Mr. Laurens...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Mr. Laurens.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I understand now.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Why didn't you tell us that Mr. Laurens was suspect?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: How am I s'posed to prove that exactly?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: By asking my good friend Silence to stand and vouch for me?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Why not?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Perhaps 'friend' is one word you can place just a little more confidence in, Kafka.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: If you speak and nobody's willing to listen, then I'll stand with you.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Silence...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: There has to be someone who'll stop by to hear out a researcher, correct?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: My drone can guide you through a safe path out.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: But how're ya gonna explain to them once I'm gone?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: This is my experiment—supervision and administration are duties I bear by all reason. Even if the specimen is stolen, my responsibility is unavoidable.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Leave any ensuing matters to me.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Silence, you ever think to yourself, 'this is gonna be a major pain in my keister?'

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I have, more or less. But I can handle it.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: But what if this is all just Kafka out to trick you into helping her?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Then after I untangle the threads, I'll find you anew.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Submitting an accurate, verified project report to Rhine Lab seniority is part of my duties too.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Seriously, you're a puzzle. Where does all your confidence in me come from?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: That would be my secret to keep, Kafka.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: I like it! Let's make a deal, then!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Next time we meet, you'll know every last secret I've got.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: And I can hope you're open to share your own, Silence.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Of course.
Two months ago...

steps.name: Apprehensive Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Researcher Silence, you don't know how thankful I am you could help me complete this experiment.

steps.name: Apprehensive Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: I've already submitted the application. Here's hoping we can find a good contract gardener to come assist us.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Be mindful to screen personnel properly. That lets us avoid unnecessary experimental losses.

steps.name: Apprehensive Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Understood. I'll start on getting that ready.

steps.name: Apprehensive Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Right, I bought you breakfast.

steps.name: Apprehensive Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Huh? Where'd it go?
In a flash, a small little figure makes off with Silence's breakfast.
A homeless boy clasps the food he's been gifted, and waves to Silence.
But next to him is that small little figure who pulls an impish face, and points at the ground.
Silence lowers her head, and sees a forgotten coin trodden beneath her foot.

steps.name: Apprehensive Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: That little thief!
This is the first time Silence met Kafka.
One week after the 'Rhine Lab Caper'...

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Mr. Laurens, verdict says we've got an innocent Kafka! Aren'tcha happy for me?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: You gettin' used to life in the slammer? Yannow, the second they found proof you made me take the fall, they just went and cancelled my whole arrest warrant.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Oh yeah, you get your present from me yet?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Guessin' not. That sucks a million. Doesn't change the huge favor Silence did me, though.

steps.name: Laurens
steps.text: You conned me. I genuinely did believe you were just a homeless wanderer.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: And Kafka's never ever gonna apologize for that.

steps.name: Laurens
steps.text: All to get revenge on me. Weren't you worried about getting yourself hurt, and her?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Well, hey, didn't get a choice. I'm too puny and small. Some kinds of justice I just gotta chance getting Silence to win back.

steps.name: Laurens
steps.text: Why would someone like you trust a Rhine Lab scientist to help you?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Yeah, why is that?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Shame Kafka only tells one woman her secrets.
